names.note: Name page of days.pravoslavie.ru for this memory is «Корнилий Крыпецкий, прп.»: «прп.» is a rank word and is stripped and the epithet kept. The day line itself declines to «Корнилия Крыпецкого». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The day line closes «(1903)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 декабря ст. ст. — «Прп. Корнилия Крыпецкого (1903).»

attestations.note: The day’s fifth entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. «Прп.» is the `venerable`, and `monk` is written from that rank and from the epithet, which is the Krypetsk monastery near Pskov; the source gives no grade and no `office` was stored. A Cyrillic grep for «Крыпецкий» over every `saint.json` returns `sabbas-of-krypetsk` alone — another forename, the founder of the same house, and another day — and `ls -d saints/cornelius*` returns seven folders, none of them this man. `fk.mjs` on the stored form returns NONE. The day page prints two hymns and both belong to the twenty thousand martyrs of Nicomedia; nothing stands under this name.
